title: Redrock Mountain
palette: burnt orange sandstone, muted vermilion, indigo shadow, peach-gold dawn
scene: A magnificent high red-rock mountain wilderness seen at adventurer eye level. A safe broad gravel switchback enters at bottom center and bends right between warm sculpted sandstone shoulders, passing a weathered natural arch to a layered jagged massif far away. Deep indigo canyons, warm high peaks, tiny dark basalt outcrops, soft drifting peach clouds. Majestic and dreamlike, but the walking route is unmistakable.
wall: flat warm red sandstone face with subtle horizontal strata and restrained cracks
floor: flat dusty red ochre gravel with small angular stones
secondary: flat cool charcoal basalt with broad quiet fractured planes
detail: flat iron mineral crust with sparse dull amber crystal flecks, not glowing lava
concept_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production biome concept for Recurant, a first-person fantasy exploration game. Create a gorgeous refined painterly pixel-art landscape in the spirit of richly colored early-1990s Lands of Lore environments, with deliberate pixel clusters, elegant atmospheric color and warm/cool relationships; not muddy, not cheap flat vector art, not photorealism. Landscape 4:3 composition, intended native 320x240 pixels with readable clusters. Full image, no frame, UI, text, labels, signatures, logos, people, creatures, weapons or first-person hands. Clearly navigable floor, eye-height first-person view, no aerial or isometric camera. Original composition, do not copy any existing game or card image. atlas_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: actual diffuse material texture atlas for a low-resolution first-person fantasy game, NOT concept art. Produce exactly ONE square image divided precisely into a 2 by 2 grid of FOUR equal borderless square texture swatches, filling every pixel. TOP LEFT: flat warm red sandstone face with subtle horizontal strata and restrained cracks. TOP RIGHT: flat dusty red ochre gravel with small angular stones. BOTTOM LEFT: flat cool charcoal basalt with broad quiet fractured planes. BOTTOM RIGHT: flat iron mineral crust with sparse dull amber crystal flecks, not glowing lava. Each is a distinct close-up FLAT ORTHOGRAPHIC SURFACE, not an object, scene, panel, cube, tile slab or perspective floor. Material surfaces alone; absolutely no horizon, scenery, shadow-casting objects, bevelled borders, text, labels, frame, gutters, gaps or margin. Neutral even ambient illumination across each square; no vignette, bright center or directional gradient. Quiet low-frequency painterly pixel texture and intentional hand-painted clusters, refined rich early-1990s fantasy color, intended to downsample crisply to 256x256 per swatch. Palette: burnt orange sandstone, muted vermilion, indigo shadow, peach-gold dawn. All four swatches should tile seamlessly on their own along both axes: match corresponding opposite edges, avoid singular center motifs, keep detail small and distributed, continue organic patterns across boundaries. Each quadrant must remain entirely its own material, sharp boundary exactly at the 50% horizontal and vertical midpoint. Do not depict four scenic landscapes. Do not paint objects on a background. Original work.
